description: corpus-drift-canary-direction-and-leak-check (#1584) correctly refuses to recommend a full mirror when drift is published-only only. But when develop is also ahead, the canary still recommends gh workflow run sync-results-data-to-published. That workflow (Build mirror branch) starts from published-results then git rm -rf results-data/bundles and checkouts develop's tree — so any community submission present only on published-results is removed even while applying a legitimate develop tip hygiene change. Residual defect after #1584: direction-aware advice without a non-destructive mirror apply path. Related: post-#1578 tip mirror #1583 used the same wipe.
